title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: The ROC curve is a graphical representation of a classifier's performance. It plots the true positive rate against the false positive rate at various threshold settings.

title: Interpreting the ROC Curve
text: A point on the ROC curve represents a specific trade-off between the true positive rate and the false positive rate. The closer the curve follows the left-hand border and then the top border of the ROC space, the more accurate the test.

title: Comparing ROC Curves
text: When comparing ROC curves, the curve that is closer to the top-left corner indicates a better performance. This is because it suggests a higher true positive rate and a lower false positive rate.

title: Analyzing the Given Probabilities
